layouts.hero_section: Asymmetric Split Hero with strong value prop: 'We bring the espresso bar to YOUR event'. Dual action buttons: Primary 'Book Your Event' (Scrolls to package/calculator) + Secondary 'Instant Quote Calculator'. Floating trust badge 'Serviced 120+ Events in 2025'. Subtle notice for street van pickup.
layouts.pricing_packages_section: Bento-style comparison grid displaying 3 primary catering packages ($7/drink, $300 Small Event, $500 Medium Event) with clear highlight on Small Event as 'Most Popular'. Each card includes guest count, unlimited status, included perks, and direct 'Book Package' CTA.
layouts.interactive_quote_calculator: An interactive widget where users drag a guest counter slider (5 to 100+ guests), select event duration, choose drink add-ons (pastries, oat milk, custom cups) to get an instant estimated quote and one-click request submission.
layouts.event_types_grid: Grid showing 4 main event categories (Corporate, Weddings, Graduations/Birthdays, Community/Sports) with high-res photos, icon badges, and tailored text.
layouts.how_it_works_workflow: 4-step clear workflow: 1. Choose Package & Date -> 2. Tailor Your Drink Menu -> 3. We Arrive & Set Up in 20 Mins -> 4. Guests Enjoy Unlimited Barista Drinks.
layouts.secondary_daily_pickup_banner: Subtle, elegant floating banner or lower section for daily street location tracking & individual online ordering: 'Looking for our daily street pop-up? Check live location & order individual drinks for pickup'.

effects: Smooth entrance animations with stagger children (staggerChildren: 0.1)
Card hover lift with shadow expansion
Interactive slider step updates with animated numerical counter

accessibility.wcag: AA compliant, high contrast text over dark or cream containers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign /app/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.js to establish Events & Catering as the PRIMARY focus.
Hero title: 'Artisanal Espresso Catering Brought directly to Your Event.'
Prominently display the 3 pricing tiers ($7/drink, $300 Small Event, $500 Medium Event) with 'Book Now' actions that navigate to /book-event or trigger the quote modal.
Include an interactive Instant Event Estimator / Calculator so users can customize guest count and see instant price estimates.
Ensure the daily street location & online ordering functionality is preserved as a secondary CTA / banner on the homepage.
Maintain high aesthetic standards: rich cream backgrounds (#F5F0E1), burgundy primary buttons (#8B1A1A), serif display headings, subtle gold highlights (#8B6914), and responsive padding.
Attach all required data-testid attributes to buttons, cards, sliders, and form triggers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12). Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
